crossRefs.note: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that…
Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard…
These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
translations.bsb: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
translations.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
translations.asv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.
